clips.text: The offside rule. Everybody argues about it. It is simpler than it sounds.
It is all about one moment. The moment a team mate passes the ball forward to you.
At that moment, look at the last defender, not counting the goalkeeper. If you are level with them, or behind them, you are onside. Play on.
But if you are already past that defender, and ahead of the ball, when it is played, you are offside. Up goes the flag.
A little small print. You cannot be offside in your own half. Or straight from a throw in, a corner, or a goal kick.
And that is it. It is where you are when the ball is played. Not where you are when you get it. Now you can explain it to everybody else.
